card.name: Verbs of giving or passing before objects
card.fires_on: Verbs of handing, giving, stealing or exchanging (given, stealing, exchange, passing, Give) and nearby spots where a countable thing is expected next. The next word is likely an item such as a sword, sheet, paper or copies.

modes.label: Give/transfer verbs
modes.description: A verb of giving, passing or exchanging that is about to be followed by a concrete object.
modes.example: One prisoner was<< given>> a sword and all 100

modes.label: Recipient after give
modes.description: The person who receives something right after Give, before the item is named.
modes.example: Give<< someone>> a piece of paper and pencil.

modes.label: Quantity slots
modes.description: A spot just before an amount of countable items, such as tablets or liters.
modes.example: The total daily dosage should not exceed <<6>> tablets.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming countable objects like tickets, flowers, packets or pieces next.
card.plain: It fires on words like give, pass or exchange, where the text is about to name a thing being handed over.
